title: 3DGS infrastructure advances: LOD, streaming, SPZ, Aholo city-scale viewer
summary: Technical summary that large-scene 3D Gaussian Splatting is becoming deployable via LOD, progressive streaming, SPZ compression, collision meshes, and browser viewers such as ManycoreTech Aholo showing city-scale billion-splat scenes.
question_it_answers: What infrastructure gaps blocked large-scene 3DGS deployment and which advances close them?

claims.text: Named advances include LOD systems, progressive streaming, SPZ compression, collision meshes, and true browser rendering.
claims.evidence: LOD systems, progressive streaming, SPZ compression, collision meshes, and true browser rendering.
claims.subject: gaussian-splatting

claims.text: ManycoreTech open-source Aholo Viewer is cited running city-scale scenes with over a billion splats in the browser.
claims.evidence: ManycoreTech’s open-source Aholo Viewer demonstrates city-scale scenes with over a billion splats running directly in the browser.
claims.subject: gaussian-splatting

judge_hints.why_must_read: Infrastructure bookmark for site-scale splat deployment versus shipping multi-gigabyte PLY files.
